@ a counter in every arm of a match~ runs on every sample
@ a match~ on a Bool target runs both arms
@ the counter of the only arm with state runs on the samples where it is not taken
@ a plain if in an arm evaluates only the branch it takes
@ a match~ as the value of a let
@ an instance of a flow without state is an arm with state
- the arms of a tuple pattern are chosen from the top
- a match~ in an arm of a match~ runs all three counters
- an if~ in an arm of a match~ runs both of its branches
- a match~ in a branch of an if~ runs when the branch is not taken
@ a match~ in a par~ has its own state and target in each replica
@ the arm of a match~ in a par~ reads the index of its replica
